slides.title: AST 101 Midterm Review
slides.speaker_notes: This is a review session, not a new lecture. Bring questions.

slides.title: What Is on the Midterm
body_text: The celestial sphere, daily motion and angles
Seasons, solstices and the Sun's path
One handwritten page of notes allowed
slides.speaker_notes: Expect to draw at least two diagrams. Diagrams earn partial credit even when the final answer is off.

slides.title: Draw These From Memory
body_text: The top-down view of the Moon's phases with the Sun on one side
Earth's orbit with the tilted axis at both solstices
Your horizon with the Sun's path in June and in December
slides.speaker_notes: If you can draw these three, you can answer most of the exam.

slides.title: Mistakes We Saw Last Year
body_text: Earth closer to the Sun in summer
A full moon rising at midnight
slides.speaker_notes: Every one of these is a good wrong answer. Make sure it is not yours.

slides.title: Practice Question
body_text: The Moon is at third quarter.
About what time does it rise?
Where in the sky is it at sunrise?
slides.speaker_notes: Work it in pairs from the top-down view before anyone shares an answer.
